text:
Four different groups of oxides are shown.
1
MgO   FeO   CuO
2
CaO   SO2   TiO2
3
PbO   CaO   Cl2O
4
NO2   Br2O   P2O5
Which statement about these groups of oxides is correct?
A
1, 2 and 3 contain basic oxides only.
B
2, 3 and 4 contain basic oxides only.
C
1 contains basic oxides only, and 4 contains acidic oxides only.
D
1 contains acidic oxides only, and 4 contains basic oxides only.

options.label: C
options.text: 1 contains basic oxides only, and 4 contains acidic oxides only.

options.label: D
options.text: 1 contains acidic oxides only, and 4 contains basic oxides only.
